rules.description: Participating States/UTs may publicize the three scholarship schemes.
rules.condition: When a State or Union Territory is a participating entity.
rules.outcome: They may give wide publicity of the Pre-Matric, Post Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities and the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) through newspapers, websites, and electronic media.
rules.evidence_quote: All participating States/UTs may give wide publicity of the aforesaid three scholarship schemes viz. Pre-Matric, Post Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities and the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) through newspapers, websites, electronic media.
